requirements_summary: POC to validate Dedicated capacity for high-concurrency chat + rerank workloads. Primary constraints: p95 latency <= 120ms for chat flows at steady-state 600 rps with bursts to 2k rps; reranker tail latency p99 <= 250ms for batch size <=16; embedding throughput for nightly indexing 20k vectors/hour. Must demonstrate predictable unit cost at committed capacity and acceptable fallback to smaller model variants during saturation. Network must support VPC peering and private control plane; KMS for customer keys required.

poc_plan: Phase 1 (3 days): Smoke tests with representative prompts to validate correctness and basic latency.
Phase 2 (5 days): Sustained soak test at target steady-state (600 rps) to validate KV cache hit rates and memory stability.
Phase 3 (72h): Burst tests including scheduled 2k rps bursts and simulated node failover to test graceful degradation and routing fallbacks.
Phase 4 (2 days): Cost modeling + throughput per-GPU analysis; finalize reserved GPU count and autoscaling policy.
Deliverables: performance report (latency percentiles, tail-loss events), suggested reserved GPU plan, recommended quantization/profile for cost SLOs.
bench_targets: Chat: p50 < 40ms, p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 220ms at 600 rps steady state
Rerank: median <= 80ms, p95 <= 160ms, p99 <= 250ms for batch sizes up to 16
Embeddings: 20k vectors/hour with <2% error for quality thresholds
Soak stability: zero OOMs for 72h, KV cache hit ratio >= 70% under steady-state
proposed_reserved_plan: Initial proposal: 8x A100-80GB equivalent GPUs reserved across two availability zones (4+4) with hot standby capacity for failover. Autoscaling policy: allow burst to 12 GPUs for short windows (billing measured by minute) with weighted routing to smaller quantized model variants when overall utilization >85%.
sla_negotiation_points: Define latency SLO windows (business hours vs. 24/7) — ZenWave insists on stricter SLA during peak hours
